objective: Implement deterministic Paper / Observed Execution Drift Metrics that compare P19-E modeled execution against governed observed-execution samples while preserving source class, lineage and claim scope; reference CI must never masquerade as live evidence.
scope: Consume content-addressed P19-E Digital Twin execution samples as the paper/model baseline
Define governed observed-execution source classes: REFERENCE_OBSERVATION, BROKER_CERTIFICATION_OBSERVATION and LIVE_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION
Bind every observed sample to exactly one paper sample identity
Measure fill-ratio drift, adverse-slippage drift, fee drift, latency drift and fill-status mismatch
Aggregate deterministic drift windows with NORMAL/WARN/FAIL severity
Require one uniform observed source class per window
Allow live_drift_validated only for genuine LIVE_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION windows meeting minimum sample count and all NORMAL thresholds
Keep canonical CI evidence REFERENCE_ONLY with live_drift_validated=false
Declare P20-H as future owner of governed real observed latency/slippage execution measurements
Generate deterministic P19-F reference evidence without broker/live claims
tests: Same paper/observed samples and policy produce identical pair/window identities
Observed sample must bind exact paper sample identity

Mixed observed source classes in one window fail closed
LIVE_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION requires minimum sample count and NORMAL severity before live_drift_validated=true
P19-F reference evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P19-F drift package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A..P19-E remain canonical complete and P19-G remains unstarted.

definition_of_done: Deterministic execution drift metric engine implemented
